about: The classification of the 49 design notes that study 2's keys B package handed to the second derivation (keys B), and, for each answer-bearing note, the evidence of whether B used it (Job study2_keys_b_design_notes, decisions N1 to N5). An answer-bearing note shows that B had access to answer guidance for that task; whether B relied on it is the separate finding. Matching answers are evidence of neither. This file records; it changes no key, decision, analysis or report.

package.verified: study/blind/blind.py verify reported no problems on 2026-11-17; every note below is read from the package's pool.json, dev.json and ambiguity.json, not from the lab's current files.

rubric.fixed: Written in the Job record before the first classification; every note was classified before any of B's files was read for evidence.

classes.background: why the task exists, what it probes or how it was built, with neither a route to the answer nor any part of its value
classes.method: how to get the answer (service, release, field, filter, join, order or the reading of a rule or word) without its value
classes.answer-bearing: the answer or part of it, a decisive count or value, or the accepted status of the key; the strongest kind present wins

rubric.keysCompared: keys-a.json at the package's lab commit 6c18afa, read with git show, never the lab's current files

findings.used: derive_b.py hard-codes the disclosed value or a rule taken from the note where the question and data do not give it, or a basis, an assumption, a test or a record cites the note
findings.derived from data: the code computes the value from the released data (or the package's own task fields) by the question's rule, and no record cites the note; reliance is not excluded, only not shown
findings.undetermined: neither shows, for example a value hard-coded where the question and data would give it

records.derivation: study/corpus2/derive_b.py, study/corpus2/test_derive_b.py and study/corpus2/keys-b.json (lab bf1fce7, bound by B_RECORD in compare_keys.py; identical to the copies decoded from the Codex task)
